verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations on the user's behalf, scoped by existing Sumsub role permissions. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. The evidence is limited to a single first-party summary line, so setup steps, available tools, transport and auth details, and real-world use are not shown. missing for 10: documented tool/operation list, connection/transport and setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use the MCP server to let AI agents perform Sumsub operations on your behalf, while keeping access controlled by your existing Sumsub role permissions.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.sumsub.com/docs/mcp-server
